# linear_users (Data Source)

Lists the users of the Linear workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_users" "members" {}

# Deactivated accounts are excluded unless asked for:
data "linear_users" "everyone" {
  include_disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_disabled` (Boolean) Whether to include deactivated accounts. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users, as Linear returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the account is active rather than deactivated.
- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a workspace admin.
- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the user's avatar.
- `display_name` (String) Short name Linear shows the user under.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `guest` (Boolean) Whether the user is a guest, seeing only the teams they were invited to.
- `id` (String) UUID of the user.
- `name` (String) Full name of the user.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone the user works in.
- `url` (String) URL of the user's Linear profile.
